title: Как Сеня устраивался на работу  (How Senya Got Hired)

segments.t: Back in the kitchen, Max beats himself up for constantly making a fool of himself in front of Chef Barinov. To cheer him up, Senya and Fedya assure him that every single cook in the kitchen has screwed up before the Chef, and Senya flashes back to his own chaotic job interview years ago.
Мы все когда-то перед ним лажали.
Настоящему повару никакой резюме не требуется.
Ну ты здесь посиди, а я сейчас.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Oh come on, relax.' Saying that Nastya should come on relax is how Barinov sets the tone with Nastya. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'Man, I really am some kind of idiot.' With the interview and point in play, Nastya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'I am always screwing up in front of the Chef.' Mentioning that he is always screwing up in front of the Chef moves the talk in a new direction.
Мы все когда-то перед ним лажали.
'Every one of us has screwed up in front of him at some point.' Nastya explains that every one of them has screwed up in front of him at some point, keeping her voice calm and direct.
'Do not sweat it.' Realizing that do not sweat it changes how Barinov handles the situation.
'You bet we have.' Noting that Barinov bets they have keeps Nastya's side of the story simple and clear.
'Here is my resume.' Even though here is his resume, Barinov keeps a steady face in front of Nastya.
Настоящему повару никакой резюме не требуется.
'A real cook does not need any resume.' Admitting that a real cook does not need any resume shows Nastya being honest for a change.
'You can tell right away by looking in his eyes.' Saying that Nastya can tell right away by looking in his eyes is how Barinov sets the tone with Nastya.

'I saw your potential immediately.' Once she saw Barinov's potential immediately, Nastya can finally tell Barinov what she means. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'Welcome to the team, son.' Between the moment and the kitchen, Barinov gives Nastya a quick, grounded response.
'Thank you, Chef.' With the moment and interview in play, Nastya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
Ну ты здесь посиди, а я сейчас.

'Well, sit right here, and I will be right back.' Realizing that Nastya should sit right here and he will be right back changes how Barinov handles the situation. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Мы все когда-то перед ним лажали.
Настоящему повару никакой резюме не требуется.
Ну ты здесь посиди, а я сейчас.
That wraps up this scene as to cheer Max up after his blunder in front of the Chef, Senya and Fedya recall how they each screwed up on their very first day in Barinov's kitchen. Until next time!
